moats.claim: App-specific components, data-source bindings and reusable modules accumulate internal workflow switching costs; low-code primitives remain widely available.

productReasons.claim: Create internal applications with AI generation, visual editing and custom code in one builder.
Use a built-in PostgreSQL-backed database alongside external APIs and data sources.
Reuse app modules and version changes through Git sync in commercial Team edition.

sponsorship.notes: Corporate sponsorship source checked. No separate corporate sponsor verified; accountable commercial steward included.

requirements.notes: Production service; may be bundled in the documented container stack.
Platform PG_DB and TOOLJET_DB; bundled or managed. Existing13.x mentioned, with upstream EOL caveat in docs.
Cache/session requirement; built-in single-container path or external stateful Redis when multiple workers/instances.

requirements.condition: Workflow scheduling and distributed workflow execution
requirements.notes: WORKER=true; external Redis persistent queue across containers.
api-gateway.tooljet.ai and python-server.tooljet.ai allowlist; not required for every manual app.
Back up both application and internal databases; optional SMTP setting exists for email workflows.

resources.memory: App4GB; PostgreSQL8GB; Redis512MB minimum (1GB production recommended)
resources.os: Ubuntu22.04+ x86_64; arm64 unsupported; Windows via WSL2/VM
resources.notes: Service-specific documented sizing, not a combined host minimum. Application4GB1vCPU and supporting PostgreSQL/Redis budgets separate.

selfHosting.notes: PostgreSQL is the actual platform backend; other SQL connectors are user data sources. Current docs predominantly describe EE/LTS containers; free CE feature availability separate.
